title: Motion (Blumenfield - Hernandez) relative to instructing the Department of City Planning, with the assistance of the Bureau of Engineering and the City…
text:
[Council File 26-1571]
Motion (Blumenfield - Hernandez) relative to instructing the Department of City Planning, with the assistance of the Bureau of Engineering and the City Attorney, to prepare and present a proposed ordinance to amend the Girard Tract Specific Plan or develop appropriate land use policies to require an analysis of wildlife habitat linkage and recreational value for all unimproved City-owned paper streets and walkways (or portions thereof) with widths of 22 feet or less when those paper streets and walkways are being improved, vacated or converted to any other uses.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted

outcome.text: Planning and Land Use Management Committee action: Approved: APPROVED Motion (Blumenfield - Hernandez) (Nov 12, 2026)
